final: SELECT o.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count, 1.0 * COUNT(t.telescregistry) / (SELECT AVG(station_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(t2.telescregistry) AS station_count FROM observatories o2 LEFT JOIN telescopes t2 ON t2.observstation = o2.observstation GROUP BY o2.observstation)) AS ratio_to_average_count FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation ORDER BY ratio_to_average_count DESC LIMIT 10
